plan: [Second-price (Vickrey) auction: bidding your true value is a dominant strategy. Overbidding risks negative payoff if you pay above your value; underbidding risks losing profitable wins. With private value $30 and independent draws, bid your value to maximize expected long-run profit. Ties resolved randomly, but no systematic benefit to deviating.]

[This is a Vickrey (second-price) auction with independent private values. Truthful bidding is a dominant strategy: bid your true value ($35). Bidding 35 maximizes expected profit because if you win you pay the second-highest bid (≤ your bid), so you never overpay relative to value; shading risks losing positive-profit wins. Ties random—35 is optimal.]

[This is a second-price sealed-bid auction. Truthful bidding is a dominant strategy: bid your private value to maximize expected profit. Overbidding can cause losses if you pay more than your value; underbidding risks losing positive-profit wins. No past rounds to adapt to. Therefore bid my value of $6.]
